title: 29 CFR 1910.22 — General requirements for walking-working surfaces
jurisdiction_scope: US federal general industry where applicable
role_scope: walking-working surfaces, housekeeping, access and hazard correction
notes: Supports clean/orderly surfaces, safe access and correction/guarding of hazardous walking-working surfaces. It does not by itself define event accessibility or public-occupancy approval.

title: 29 CFR 1910.178 — Powered industrial trucks
jurisdiction_scope: US federal general industry where applicable
model_product_scope: powered industrial trucks within standard scope
notes: Requires operator training/evaluation for covered powered industrial trucks and identifies workplace conditions such as pedestrian traffic and ramps. It does not cover every powered device used in live events.
